text:
```yaml
name: Repo Commands

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [repo-command]

jobs:
  handle-command:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Parse command
        id: parse
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const payload = github.context.payload;
            const command = payload.client_payload?.command ?? '';
            const args = payload.client_payload?.args ?? [];
            core.setOutput('command', command);
            core.setOutput('args', JSON.stringify(args));

      - name: Trigger release workflow
        if: steps.parse.outputs.command == 'makerelease'
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: 'release.yml'
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: 'main'
          wait-for-completion: true
          wait-timeout-seconds: 300
          wait-interval-seconds: 10

      - name: Handle other commands
        if: steps.parse.outputs.command != 'makerelease'
        run: echo "Command '${{ steps.parse.outputs.command }}' not recognized."
```
